payload.title: Working with `Pandas`
payload.summary: This notebook explores the integration of Pandas with Pyleoclim for paleoclimate data analysis. It demonstrates how to export Pyleoclim Series to Pandas Series, perform unit conversions, select data based on time or value criteria, and handle CSV import/export. The notebook also covers resampling techniques and operations with MultipleSeries objects, showcasing the enhanced capabilities for data processing and visualization.
goals: Learn to export Pyleoclim `Series` to Pandas `Series`.
Select portions of a time series based on time or value criteria

section_blurbs.blurb: Introduction to the integration of Pandas with Pyleoclim, highlighting the limitations of Pandas for paleogeosciences and the goals of the notebook.
section_blurbs.heading: Working with `Pandas`

section_blurbs.blurb: Demonstrates how to export a Pyleoclim Series to a Pandas Series and apply Pandas methods to it.
section_blurbs.heading: .to_pandas()

section_blurbs.blurb: Explains how Pyleoclim handles date string semantics for converting time units, with examples of plotting converted data.
section_blurbs.heading: Unit conversions

section_blurbs.blurb: Shows how to use Pandas semantics to select specific intervals or values from paleoclimate data.
section_blurbs.heading: Selection

section_blurbs.blurb: Describes the process of exporting and importing data to and from CSV files using Pandas.
section_blurbs.heading: CSV Import/Export

section_blurbs.blurb: Covers the resampling of time series data to different temporal resolutions using Pyleoclim's resample function.
section_blurbs.heading: Resampling

section_blurbs.blurb: Illustrates how to handle MultipleSeries objects in Pyleoclim and export them to Pandas DataFrames for further analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: Pandas operations with MultipleSeries objects

section_blurbs.blurb: Explains how to align MultipleSeries objects to a common time axis and visualize the data using Seaborn.
section_blurbs.heading: Aligning to a common axis

section_blurbs.blurb: Concludes with a summary of the integration of Pandas within Pyleoclim and its benefits for data processing and visualization.
section_blurbs.heading: Summary

inputs: EPICA Dome C CO2 record data
